name: Product Design Workflow
description: Design how a user will use what this ticket adds or changes: who it is for, what using it looks like, the few things they must know, then every surface, state, word and graphic they meet, with or without a screen. Simple, intuitive, the least work for the user, pleasing to look at and consistent with the design system. Produces one interactive design file that shows the product design, and product-design.md.

stages.name: Understand the user and what exists
Design every state and write every word
